text.text_excerpt: I truly enjoyed my stay at the Brent House. The staff were so friendly and inviting. They went the extra mile to make sure our stay in New Orleans was awesome. The room was spacious, IMMACULATELY CLEAN, and provided all the amenities we needed for our trip. I love the location, close to the French Quarter but far enough away to not be in the middle of the hustle and bustle. I will defiantly book a stay at this location in the future.

Party of one here for a family member having cancer related surgery. Everyone here has been incredible, attentive, and caring. The room was very comfortable and clean. The closeness of Brent House to the hospital is a huge benefit for patients and family/friends alike. Within a three minute walk is a PJ's coffee, pharmacy, gift shop, cafeteria, barber/beauty shop. There is an atrium which is spectacular and provides a place to gather. A fountain and a beautiful Christmas tree complete the scene. If you are having a procedure or are supporting someone who is at Ochsner in Nola you cannot go wrong by staying here.

This nice hotel located next door to the large Ochsner's on Jefferson Highway was a wow! My friend stayed there while attending a job interview. I imagine it would prove convenient for out of town care givers and families alike. I dropped my friend off and went to search for parking. I was a bit confused and ended up back at the drop off area. We quickly ran up to his room to drop his bag off. The biggest surprise was the indoors live garden atrium with water feature. It was dark but I snapped a pic. His room was comparable to any big hotel chain, I personally found it to be very spacious, nice and of modern decor.
